           BOTULINUM

         Toxin of Bacillus Botulinum


Food poisoning from canned spinach produced a clinical picture suggested
        in a bulbar paresis.


Eye symptoms, ptosis, double vision, blurred vision.


Difficulty in swallowing and breathing, choking sensation; weakness and
        uncertainty in walking, "blind staggers", dizziness, thickening of speech.
        Cramping pain in stomach.


Mask-like expression of face, due to weakness of facial muscles. Severe
        constipation.



Dose.--  Higher potencies.
